title: Make every printed task-sync `export --rebuild` remedy runnable as printed
outcome: Make every printed task-sync `export --rebuild` remedy runnable as printed
acceptance: Every task-sync refusal that names a rebuild export tells the caller to run the same export again with `--rebuild` added (or prints a complete invocation including the data directory, branch and profile flags), so it is accepted as printed in the task-only, notes (`--include-notes --origin-machine`), memories (`--include-memories`) and non-default `--branch` profiles

A behavioural CLI regression test reaches the ImportConflict refusal (a held task also changed here), reruns the export it ran with the printed rebuild flag in a non-default profile, and the rebuild succeeds and is followed by a clean import, export and push
Fix in the next round right after the w-c39164e2c07b landing
